installPrompt.title: Install PPS Portal
installPrompt.iosHint: Add to your home screen to use it like an app and get notifications.
installPrompt.androidHint: Add to your home screen to open it quickly like an app.

iosSteps.safariOnly: ⚠️ iOS only allows this from Safari. Please reopen this page in Safari, then follow the steps below.
iosSteps.step1: Tap the Share button (square with an up arrow) in Safari's bottom toolbar.
iosSteps.step2: Scroll up in the list and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
iosSteps.step3: Tap “Add” in the top-right corner, then open the app from the new icon on your home screen.
iosSteps.whyBother: This step is required before iOS will allow push notifications — it's Apple's rule, not an app issue.
